description_en: First-person funerary inscription in 35 chapters composed by Augustus himself. Originally inscribed on bronze pillars outside his Mausoleum in Rome. The most complete surviving copy is the Monumentum Ancyranum in Ankara, Turkey (Latin and Greek).
notes: Self-presentation, not neutral history. Omits defeats and selectively narrates achievements.

title_en: Building program: 82 temples restored in 28 BCE
title_zh: 建筑计划：前28年修复82座神庙
description_en: Augustus claimed in the Res Gestae to have restored 82 temples of the gods in Rome in 28 BCE alone.
notes: Part of the broader Augustan building program transforming Rome from brick to marble
